name: Tankardstown
questions: Satellite imagery shows a large yard across the road, about 100 m south-east, full of trucks, trailers and caravans beside a big shed. What business is it, what hours does it run, and how much HGV traffic does it put past the gate?

The listing says the house 'benefits from private services'. Is the water from a well (with a recent water test and yield), and is drainage a septic tank or treatment unit? How old is it, and does it have a certificate?

Is there a floor plan? When was the house built, is the attic (hatch in the utility) floored or convertible, and can you show the 0.71-acre boundary on a map, including which parts are fenced for dogs?
Is fibre broadband connected (BuyerIQ lists 102 Mb full fibre at the address)? Has the house had a radon test, and has the site or the L3976 at the gate ever flooded?
BuyerIQ shows three planning applications within 1 km, one an active build. Do you know what they are, and is anything planned for the fields beside the house?

ai.why: A sound, well-kept single-storey bungalow with all four bedrooms on the ground floor, 10 minutes from Athy's Dublin trains, at €450k with a C3 BER. But at 150 m² with one living room and two bathrooms it is compact for six, it is plain and dated inside, and a truck and caravan yard sits about 100 m across the road.

electricity.detail: Connected; an occupied, furnished house with light fittings throughout, though the listing doesn't state the supply.

water.detail: Private supply: the listing says the house 'benefits from private services', most likely a well. Type not stated; ask for a water test.

sewer.detail: Private drainage per 'private services', most likely a septic tank or treatment unit; type, age and certification not given.

internet.detail: Fibre likely: BuyerIQ lists '102 Mb full fibre' at the address, but gives no provider and the listing doesn't mention broadband. Confirm on nbi.ie with R14 PE89.

groundFloorBedroom.detail: Single-storey bungalow (confirmed by the front photo): Bedroom 1 (3.46 × 3.55 m, fitted wardrobes) has its own en suite with a shower, and all four bedrooms are on the one level.

bedsNote: all on the ground floor; plus guest WC
heating: Oil-fired central heating; open fireplace in the sitting room
tagline: A tidy four-bedroom bungalow on 0.71 acres among fields on a country road, about 10 minutes south of Athy and its Dublin trains.

pros.text: Single storey, every bedroom on the ground floor
pros.detail: Four bedrooms of 11–12.5 m² each; Bedroom 1 (3.46 × 3.55 m) has an en suite shower, so Gabor's parents need no stairs at all.

pros.text: Athy and its Dublin trains about 10 minutes away
pros.detail: About 6.5 km to Athy (shops, supermarkets, GPs); Athy station has about 10 direct trains to Heuston each weekday, roughly 1 hour.
Ardscoil na Tríonóide, Athy (mixed, 882 pupils, 74% progression in an older Irish Times table) is about 7 km; Knockbeg College (boys, 92% in 2016) about 7.7 km.
Big front lawn and a south-west-facing rear garden; satellite shows farmland on two sides. Less than the ideal acre, but room for the dogs.
212 kWh/m²/yr, better than most houses on the list; still oil, so a heat pump is a later job.
Described as 'superbly presented'; detached garage 6.51 × 4.85 m with roller door, gravel drive and double entrance.

cons.detail: 150 m² (rooms sum to about 155 m²): one sitting room (5.55 × 4.04 m) plus an 8.30 × 3.45 m kitchen/dining; no playroom or second living room.
A small en suite (1.03 × 3.06 m, electric shower) and one family bathroom with corner bath and shower, plus a guest WC.

cons.text: Truck and caravan yard across the road
cons.detail: Satellite imagery (date unknown) shows a large yard of trucks, trailers and caravans with a shed about 100 m south-east; a neighbouring bungalow sits right beside, about 40 m away.
Midland Regional Portlaoise (all ages) is about 35 km; Naas is 16+ only, and Tallaght or Crumlin are an hour or more.
Pine kitchen and doors, patterned carpets throughout, curtains; a standard rendered bungalow whose only feature is the sitting-room fireplace.
'Private services' only: probably a well and septic tank, type, age and certificate not given.
On the L3976 local road, about 5 km from Ballylinan and 6.5 km from Athy; the primary school is 2.8 km. Every errand is a drive.

cons.text: Primary quality and floor plan unknown
cons.detail: No inspection report could be read for Shanganamore NS, and no floor plan was found on MyHome.
